description.zh:
待订阅的域名列表，支持批量查询域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
如果不传该参数，默认为账号下的所有域名订阅报表交付任务。
description.en: The domain name that you want to track. You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request. If you specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,). If you do not specify a domain name, operations reports are updated for all domain names in your Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 定制任务的结束时间。使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The end time of the operations report. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 新定制的报表ID列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The IDs of operations reports that you want to update. Separate IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 定制任务的开始时间。使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start time of the operations report. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

descriptions.en: > Each account can call this operation up to three times per second.
